narrative.scqa_md:
Royal Business Bank is a $4.2B in assets regional bank regulated by FDIC, operating since 2008 with 201 employees. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 1.9/5. The deepest capability gap is Speech-to-Text & Conversation Intelligence at 1.3/5 against a 2.0 peer median [E-007]. Next is In-Session Personalization at 1.6/5 against a 2.5 peer median [E-056].

Third is Application Intake & Data Capture at 1.7/5 against a 2.5 peer median. The issue register adds Capability gap: Sandbox Environments (high severity). The issue register adds Capability gap: Fail-Fast Culture (high severity). The pattern is corroborated across the assessment's evidence index [E-001, E-003, E-006, E-009].

The roster shows no CISO — a named ownership gap for the capabilities below. The question for Royal Business Bank is whether to close Speech-to-Text & Conversation Intelligence first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. Royal Business Bank should lead with Databricks (79/100 fit) against Sandbox Environments, then sequence Tableau behind it. Closing Speech-to-Text & Conversation Intelligence to the peer median alone is worth 0.7 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain.
